run_record.scope: Question-led bounded deep scan; not systematic or exhaustive. Paper count includes methodological papers and reanalysis, not 20 independent experiments.

framing.population: Human decision makers and evaluated LLMs; empirical software builds where relevant.
framing.intervention: Structured perspective, task methods, evidence diversity, alternatives and evaluation.
framing.comparators: Generic role prompting, unaided judgment, independent samples/voting, and neighboring existing lens mechanisms.
framing.outcomes: Accuracy, useful distinct findings, feasible alternatives, false assurance, effort and applicability to the current library.
framing.designs: Primary experiments, methodological studies, simulation, empirical software studies, case study and direct methodological critique.
framing.timeframe: No fixed publication-year restriction; live queries on the research date.

run_record.timestamp_precision: Research date and UTC receipt date retained; no fabricated per-call timestamps.

discovery.canary: Rich response including tier=deep and usage/quota fields inspected; no free-tier/sign-in degradation observed. Account identity/tier not independently inferred.
discovery.coverage: Only first result page of each query. All reported is_end=false; returned counts are not corpus totals. No saturation claimed.

reception.auth_canary: search_collections returned accessible collections, not a sign-in error.
reception.alias_rule: Twenty selected papers plus two alternate coordinates; versions are not independent evidence and tallies are not summed.
reception.second_order: Incoming contexts for interpersonal perspective and reference-class forecasting; targeted later critique of quantitative perspective averaging. Follow-up papers P17, P19 and P20.
reception.coverage: Live tallies for 19 selected DOI coordinates; P06 indexed without a tally. Not all contrasting statements for every paper were read. Initial multi-seed graph capped at90 edges and was dominated by one seed; separate graphs for P03 (279 edges) and P11 (60 edges) were not truncated.
reception.direction_check: search_literature citation snippets included outgoing references. citation_graph(direction=in) used for reception; mixed type labels read in context.
reception.limitations: No matched indexed notice is not proof that no notice exists anywhere. Supporting/contrasting counts are not quality votes or independent replications.

run_record.terminal_reason: Preset deep-mode paper scope reached. Concrete source defects and membership distinctions support design recommendations; comparative agent behavior is the next discriminating evidence, not additional undirected literature.
run_record.research_artifact_status: Local working-tree notes; no commit or push. Private paper collection deposited and verified.
run_record.methodology_changes: No runtime skill, roster, selector, install or release changed.

screening_summary.meaning: Included is20 selected papers plus2 correction notices. Other discovery records were not selected for the bounded synthesis; this is not a formal quality screen or PRISMA review.

source_decision_log.interpretation: The connector calls all logged decisions screened. Most excluded records were discovery returns not selected for follow-up, not full-text quality-screened studies.
